description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain management functionalities, specifically testing activation address retrieval and handling of stateless and stateful grains. It defines test classes, interfaces, and implementations related to Orleans grains, including stateless worker grains and normal grains, and verifies behaviors through various test cases.

classes.name: ManagementGrainTests
classes.description: Contains test cases for Orleans management grain, focusing on activation address retrieval and behavior with stateless and stateful grains.

classes.name: IDumbWorker
classes.description: Test interface for a stateless worker grain used in activation address tests.

classes.name: DumbWorker
classes.description: Implementation of a stateless worker grain with no internal state, used for testing.

classes.name: IDumbGrain
classes.description: Test interface for a stateful grain that supports activation address querying.

classes.name: DumbGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a stateful grain with simple DoNothing method for testing.

methods.name: GetActivationAddressTest
methods.description: Test method that verifies management grain's ability to retrieve grain activation addresses and handle stateless and stateful grains appropriately.

methods.name: DoNothing
methods.description: A trivial method on grains to simulate activity without side effects.
